title: Pulaka in Coconut Cream
description: Tuvaluan pulaka is giant swamp taro, traditionally cooked and served with coconut cream. This uses ordinary edible taro as a substitute.

steps.instruction: Peel store-bought edible taro, cut into 4–5 cm pieces and rinse. Do not use unidentified or wild taro.
Boil taro in ample fresh water 30–40 minutes until fully soft, then drain and discard cooking water.
Warm coconut cream over low heat with a pinch of salt, stirring until smooth and steaming.
Spoon coconut cream over hot taro and serve immediately.
